visualCharacteristics: Centered team/contributor profile cards in a responsive multi-up grid: a portrait image on top, then a name heading, a role/occupation line, and a row of social links.
contentPattern: One row per person: portrait image cell, name cell, role cell, and an optional social-links cell. The image cell is detected by content.
usage: About/team pages — contributor and guide grids ('Our Contributors', 'WKND Guides').
